metadata.title: Exotic involutions on irreducible 4-manifolds from Real Seiberg--Witten theory
metadata.abstract: Using Real Seiberg--Witten theory, Miyazawa constructed infinitely many exotic involutions on ${\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2}$, and Baraglia extended this construction to $X\#{\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2}$ for a broad class of $4$-manifolds $X$ equipped with an involution $c$. We show that, under suitable Real Seiberg--Witten hypotheses, the ${\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2}$ summand can be omitted when $X$ is non-spin and the complement of the fixed locus is simply-connected. Our construction also yields infinite families of topologically isotopic but smoothly non-isotopic embeddings of the branch surface in the quotient $X/\langle c\rangle$. As applications, we construct anti-holomorphic involutions on irreducible, simply-connected projective surfaces of general type with infinitely many exotic copies, none of which is anti-symplectic with respect to any orientation-compatible symplectic form. These surfaces include cyclic branched covers of $\mathbb{CP}^2$ and complete intersections of multidegree $(2,4k)$ in $\mathbb{CP}^4$.
metadata.comment: 24 pages, no figures, comments are welcome

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 不可约四维流形上的exotic对合
analysis.workSummary: 在适当Real Seiberg–Witten假设、X非自旋且不动点集补空间单连通时，作者把此前X#反向CP²上的exotic对合构造推进到X本身，无需额外反向CP²连通和；同时在商中得到拓扑同痕但非光滑同痕的分支曲面嵌入无穷族。
techniques: 去掉反向CP²连通和的构造
分支曲面嵌入及对合的光滑区别
射影曲面的反全纯对合
analysis.breakthrough: 应用到不可约、单连通一般型射影曲面，原反全纯对合有无穷多个exotic副本；这些exotic副本对任何定向相容辛形式都不是反辛的。例子含CP²循环分支覆盖及CP⁴中多次数(2,4k)完全交。
analysis.limitations: 非自旋、补空间单连通及Real不变量条件均不可省略。不能把exotic副本的反辛障碍错误施加到原反全纯对合，或推成全部不可约四维流形都有此构造。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 四维规范理论与辛拓扑的重要构造，但主要是光滑拓扑而非几何流分析。
